title: AMADA HOMEFURNISHING Adjustable Bed Frame with Massage, App-Controlled Twin XL Adjustable Bed Base with 4 USB Ports & Under-Bed LED Light, Wireless Electric Bed Frame, 4 Height Options, TXL2
features: Charging & LED Lighting: This adjustable bed frame features a USB-A and USB-C charging port on each side, making it easy to keep your devices fully powered. A soft under-bed nightlight can be switched on to help guide you in the dark without having to turn on overhead lights that may disturb your partner.

Adjustable Head & Foot Angles: This twin XL adjustable bed base can elevate your head up to 65° and feet up to 45° for customized sleep and relaxation. Whether you're watching TV, reading, reducing snoring, or enjoying the Zero Gravity setting for enhanced circulation and pressure relief, this bed frame adapts effortlessly to your needs.

Relaxing Massage Feature: Experience soothing comfort with this adjustable bed thanks to head and foot massage options controlled by 2 motors. With three intensity levels and modes, you can target specific areas to relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and promote better circulation—all controlled via the SmartBed App or included remote.

4 Leg Height Options: The adjustable twin XL bed frame includes three leg sections (2″, 3″, and 8″) that can be configured to create leg heights of 8″, 10″, 11″ and 13″ tall. Whether you need a lower level to get in and out of bed or want more storage space underneath, you can choose the ideal bed height for your space.

Easy 3-Step Setup: Setting up your electric bed frame is hassle-free without the need for tools. Simply secure the bed legs, connect the electronics, then insert the mattress retainer bar. Spend less time on assembly and more time enjoying your new adjustable bed foundation.

Comprehensive Warranty & Support: Enjoy peace of mind with our 5-year warranty on the bed frame and motor, and a 1-year warranty on the soft padding. Our dedicated support team is here to assist you with any questions or concerns, ensuring a worry-free experience.
